sections.title: gno.land Networks
sections.note: Testnets are renamed and replaced every few weeks. This list deliberately names only mainnet; for whichever testnet is current, follow the docs link — it is the one URL that stays correct.

entries.name: Gno networks
entries.description: Start here. The canonical list: the current testnet and its RPC, staging, deployment files, and archives of every past network. Testnet tokens come from the Gno Faucet Hub, listed under Tools below.

entries.name: Mainnet
entries.description: Chain id gnoland-1, live since 12 September 2026, served at gno.land. RPC https://rpc.gno.land:443. Real GNOT; there is no mainnet faucet.

entries.name: Staging
entries.description: Rolling redeploy of master; state is best-effort and gets wiped on breaking changes.
